summary: SOLAI Ltd (NYSE: SLAI) filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing the commercial launch of Solode Neo, a personal AI computer priced at $399. The product supports self-hosted AI agents and integrates with third-party frameworks. No merger, acquisition, tender, restructuring, or other special-situation event is disclosed. The filing is a routine business update and product announcement. As a foreign private issuer's periodic report, it does not map to any US special-situation category. No deal terms apply.
